name: default-marquee
title: Default Marquee
blurb: Two-row infinite scroll carousel of review cards, moving in opposite directions.
description: Testimonial display with two marquee rows scrolling horizontally in opposite directions. Review cards show avatar, name, username, and body. Includes pause-on-hover, noise texture overlay, and gradient fade edges for seamless loop effect.
use_when: Showcasing customer reviews or testimonials in a continuous, eye-catching scroll pattern.
avoid_when: Content-heavy testimonials — the scrolling motion makes text hard to read for long quotes.
a11y: Pause-on-hover helps accessibility, but there is no keyboard pause control and no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
